passage:
Every morning, Mr. Kuo ran past the school gate at 6:40. Students on early duty often saw him. He was not fast, but he never missed a day.
One cold morning, a student asked him why he ran even when the weather was bad.
Mr. Kuo said, "I do not run because every morning is comfortable. I run because I promised myself."
The student thought about this during exam week. He did not feel like studying, but he remembered Mr. Kuo. He studied for twenty minutes, then another twenty.
Months later, the student saw Mr. Kuo again and thanked him. Mr. Kuo was surprised. He had never tried to teach anyone. He was only running.
Sometimes discipline becomes a lesson for people watching.
